exports.name: Connection
exports.signature: public resource Connection: network
exports.ownership_contract: Affine native handle dependent on a live Network provider. Public read/write/close transfer the Connection. Read/write borrow it only inside their callee, then cleanup closes the handle; close returns ownership on failure.

exports.name: Chunk
exports.signature: public record Chunk[const N: u64]:
exports.ownership_contract: Fixed-size byte-array value with bounded length and EOF flag. Runtime provider results validate length against the static capacity.

exports.name: Connected
exports.signature: public result Connected:
exports.ownership_contract: Fresh acquisition carrier transfers Connection on success; scalar error owns no native handle.

exports.name: Read
exports.signature: public result Read[const N: u64]:
exports.ownership_contract: Fresh fixed-size Chunk or scalar error. Public network.read consumes Connection; native read_resource borrows it until wrapper cleanup releases it.

exports.name: Written
exports.signature: public result Written:
exports.ownership_contract: Scalar accepted-byte count or error. Public network.write consumes Connection; fixed input bytes and native IO operation borrow during the call.

exports.name: Failure
exports.signature: public record Failure:
exports.ownership_contract: Owns the uncompleted Connection and scalar code after completion failure; destruction must release exactly once while provider lives.

exports.name: Closed
exports.signature: public result Closed:
exports.ownership_contract: Successful completion has scalar bool; failure transfers resource ownership in Failure. Neither branch permits a provider escape.

exports.name: read
exports.signature: public func read[const N: u64](connection: Connection) -> Read[N] effects(network):
exports.ownership_contract: Consumes its affine Connection, returns an independent fixed-size Chunk or scalar error, and closes the handle when its local owner is destroyed. No repeated use of the consumed caller variable.

exports.name: write
exports.signature: public func write[const N: u64](connection: Connection, data: FixedArray[u8, N]) -> Written effects(network):
exports.ownership_contract: Consumes its affine Connection and borrows fixed-size input; returns scalar count/error and closes the local owner at return. No repeated use of the consumed caller variable.

exports.name: close
exports.signature: public func close(connection: Connection) -> Closed effects(network):
exports.ownership_contract: Completes handle on success or returns live resource in failure; source/IR ownership path requires qualification.
